correctness.evidence: Independent exact enumeration of free trees through n=12 and exact adjacency/complement characteristic polynomials gives all singleton generalized classes through n=11 and, at n=12, 549 singletons plus one pair. Direct recomputation verifies the displayed non-isomorphic witness pair and both shared characteristic polynomials. Adjacency-only non-singleton counts 2,10,8,60,119 and the n=12 class-size distribution also reproduce exactly.

originality.evidence: Qualified to checked literature. Wang arXiv:1410.2164 gives a sufficient arithmetic DGS criterion; Ji-Wang-Zhang arXiv:2310.00846 gives a sufficient discriminant criterion for signed trees; Zhu arXiv:2608.24137v2 gives component/tree-forcing criteria and DGS double-star families. None of the inspected results reports the exhaustive n<=12 free-tree generalized-spectrum census or the unique first pair at n=12, and targeted searches did not locate one.

value.evidence: The result fixes the first finite threshold at which generalized spectra fail to distinguish trees and provides the unique witness pair and complete small-order class distributions, useful as a benchmark and as a concrete boundary case for DGS criteria.

checked_sources.title: A simple arithmetic criterion for graphs being determined by their generalized spectra
checked_sources.finding: Sufficient walk-matrix arithmetic criterion, not a small-tree census.

checked_sources.title: Generalized spectral characterization of signed trees
checked_sources.finding: Theorem 1.2 is a sufficient discriminant criterion; Example 1 concerns a 14-vertex adjacency-cospectral pair prevented from being generalized-cospectral under its hypotheses.

checked_sources.title: Main-Factor Allocation and Coronal Realizability for Generalized Cospectral Mates of Trees
checked_sources.finding: Structural component/tree-forcing results and DGS double-star families; no n<=12 exhaustive free-tree generalized-spectrum census in the inspected full text.

limitations: Originality is to the best of inspected literature, not exhaustive priority.
DGS is only within the tree class in this record.
The proof is exact finite computation, not formal proof verification.
